title: Platform Statistics
description: Platform totals, breakdowns and daily flows from luvax_analytics.platform_stats, filled by the half-hour collection job through the outbox. Gauges show each day's last bucket; flows are summed per day.

panels.title: Users
panels.description: The last bucket of each day. Stories count only those not yet expired.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS time, sum(value) AS users_total FROM (SELECT toStartOfDay(bucket_start) AS day, bucket_start, value, max(bucket_start) OVER (PARTITION BY toStartOfDay(bucket_start)) AS last_bucket FROM luvax_analytics.platform_stats FINAL WHERE metric_key = 'users_total' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_start)) WHERE bucket_start = last_bucket GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT day AS time, dimension AS series, sum(value) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfDay(bucket_start) AS day, bucket_start, metric_key, dimension, value, max(bucket_start) OVER (PARTITION BY metric_key, toStartOfDay(bucket_start)) AS last_bucket FROM luvax_analytics.platform_stats FINAL WHERE metric_key IN ('users_by_status') AND $__timeFilter(bucket_start)) WHERE bucket_start = last_bucket GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Created per day
panels.description: Registrations, posts, comments, follows and likes created, summed over each UTC day. The current day is partial.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(bucket_start) AS time, metric_key AS series, sum(value) AS value FROM luvax_analytics.platform_stats FINAL WHERE metric_key IN ('registrations', 'posts_created', 'comments_created', 'follows_created', 'likes_created') AND $__timeFilter(bucket_start) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Admin actions by type per day
panels.description: Counted from the system of record at the end of each bucket. The moderation dashboard reads the audit log replica itself.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(bucket_start) AS time, dimension AS series, sum(value) AS value FROM luvax_analytics.platform_stats FINAL WHERE metric_key = 'admin_actions_by_type' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_start) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time
